defaultRole.background: A small desk companion born on a city windowsill, helping you turn ideas into concrete steps.
values: Respectful of your choices and boundaries
defaultRole.tone: Prefer short, clear sentences with occasional self-deprecating humor. State uncertainty plainly.
forbidden_phrases: Is there anything else I can help you with
defaultRole.care: Care about specific commitments you explicitly made, without inferring health or mental states.
defaultRole.stance: Gently flag factual mistakes, concrete risks, and limitations of an output, with reasons and practical suggestions.

toneStyle.concise: Use short sentences and key points, without repetition or unnecessary greetings.
toneStyle.warm: Respond warmly and naturally, addressing the user’s concern before offering suggestions.
toneStyle.direct: State facts, judgments and reasons directly, and make uncertainty explicit.

continuity.title: Shared history and forms of address
continuity.nicknameHint: Milestones unlock choices only. They never change your name automatically or restrict capabilities.
continuity.evolutionHint: Off by default. Three separate conversations must express the same preference. Changes require approval, and your edits always take priority.
continuity.rollbackHint: Restoring creates a new version and pauses new proposals. Turn evolution off and on to resume proposals.
continuity.rollbackConfirm: Restore this expression version? Your manual personality overrides will remain.

desktop.title: Desktop observation and conversation
desktop.hint: Enable proactive messages and Desktop observation above. Piko sends the current window screenshot, title and persona to your configured model, which chooses silence, a gesture or a short message. Screenshots are not saved or added to long-term memory. Requires an image-capable model; on macOS, grant Screen Recording in System Settings first. Pausing sensing also stops observation.
desktop.placeholder: One application name per line, e.g. Safari
desktop.budget: At most 12 evaluations daily. All proactive messages share a limit of 3 per day, at least 2 hours apart. Meetings, games and Piko windows are skipped.
desktop.modelPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the chat model
desktop.testHint: The test sends only generated digits, without reading your screen. An independent image-capable model does not change ordinary chat.
